description: MMS gate: run the inline esm-spec 6.6 tests of problems/latlon_advection_zonal_upwind.esm (model ZonalAdvectionUpwind, test mms_solid_body_rotation_upwind) at the problem's default resolution (NLON=144, NLAT edge-bound to 5) through each binding's official simulation pathway. The assertions and their tolerances live in the problem file itself; this manifest only routes the runners.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator

python._doc: Pinned to match the cartesian problems' convention: LSODA at 1e-12/1e-14 keeps Python temporal truncation negligible against the spatial goldens (the upwind-advection system is non-stiff but weakly dissipative, where loose explicit tolerances would add spurious dissipation on top of the scheme's own).
